test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"distribution."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Distribution"** means the act of giving out or delivering something to different people or places. (कुछ वितरित करने या कहीं सामान पहुँचाने की क्रिया, वितरण)

 
 
• **Example:** *The **distribution**__ of food during the famine was handled by multiple NGOs.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**:

The world is going through a deep recession. At such a time, one thing we need in abundance is jobs for the semi-skilled and unskilled. This is the only way in which equal __**distribution**__ of wealth can take place. The healthcare industry is ideally poised to occupy this position. The IT industry hires people from the upper-middle strata and rich families, usually engineers, ______ (2) ______ the health care industry hires nurses, to the tune of eighty per cent of the jobs created, from the lower economic strata. Global health care is a 4.5-trillion rupee industry, second only to the agro-industry. Even then, health care ______ (3) ______ only eight per cent of the world's population. Policymakers should look at the healthcare industry as not only an industry which addresses pain but also as one which can ______ (4) ______ the economy. The last century was driven by machines that addressed human toil and it is strongly believed that this century will be driven by health care. This, however, will only happen if policymakers make a conscious effort to ______ (5) ______ the right policies in place soon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Spending"** refers to the act of giving money for goods and services. (सरकार या किसी संस्‍था द्वारा ख़र्च की गई धन राशि)
 
• **"Partition" **means dividing something into parts or sections. (कमरा, कार्यालय आदि को दो या अधिक हिस्‍सों में विभक्त करने वाली वस्‍तु (प्रायः पतली या अस्‍थायी दीवार); विभाजक दीवार)
 
• **"Earning"** means acquiring money or income through work or investment. ((कठिन परिश्रम से) कुछ पाने का अधिकारी हो जाना)

The correct answer is **"whereas."**
